data.name: Masoud
data.gender_notes: Masoud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Masoud is an Arabic name that symbolizes bravery and strength, reminiscent of a lion. It is a popular name in Islamic tradition, signifying courage and fearlessness. The name Masoud carries the meaning “Lion-like” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masoud usually hope their child will grow to embody lion-like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the lion is a symbol of bravery and strength, reflecting the qualities of a true believer.
data.etymology: Masoud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion-like.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masoud total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مسعود
in_arabic.long_meaning: مسعود هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ومعناه الذى ينجح ويوفق، ويتكون من ثلاثة أحرف، ميم وسين وعين، وهو اسم مشتق من الفعل سعد، ويستخدم هذا الاسم فى nhiều الثقافات الإسلامية، وله مكانة عالية فى التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: مسعود
in_urdu.long_meaning: مسعود ایک اسلامی نام ہے جس کا مطلب کامیاب اور کامیابی والا ہوتا ہے، یہ نام عربوں کے زمانے سے استعمال ہو رہا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن پاک میں بھی آیا ہے، یہ نام برصغیر میں بھی بہت استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मसूद
in_hindi.long_meaning: मसूद एक इस्लामिक नाम है जिसका अर्थ सफल और समृद्धि वाला होता है, यह नाम अरबी संस्कृति से आया है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरान में भी है, यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में भी बहुत प्रयोग होता है

in_pashto.name: مسعود
in_pashto.long_meaning: مسعود دا اسلامی نوم دی چې معنی بریالی او بریالتیا ده، دا نوم عربو څخه راغلی دی، او دا په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې ډیر استعمال کیږي

data.cultural_impact: Masoud is a name that resonates with the rich cultural heritage and legacy of the Islamic world, particularly the Persian influence. Masoud is not only an Arabic name, but it is also frequently used in the Persian language and in regions with large Persian-speaking populations, such as Iran and Afghanistan. The name Masoud evokes a sense of pride, courage, and resilience, reflecting the collective spirit of these communities.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, Masoud is a deeply spiritual name that holds significant meaning for Muslims who believe in the power of Allah (God) to grant strength and courage. The name Masoud is said to have been derived from the Arabic root "soud," meaning "lion." In Islamic tradition, the lion is often seen as a symbol of power, courage, and fearlessness. By bestowing the name Masoud upon a child, parents are wishing for their child to manifest these qualities and to face life's challenges with strength and determination. Additionally, the name Masoud is said to have a protective nature, shielding the individual from harm. This spiritual significance of the name Masoud transcends cultural boundaries, resonating with Muslims from all walks of life and backgrounds.
